# SkillRock — Full Curriculum & Extended Syllabus Directory

> Complete course syllabi, module breakdowns, evaluation benchmarks, and learning objectives across all technical domains on SkillRock.

- Canonical Website: https://skillrock.onrender.com
- Course Catalog: https://skillrock.onrender.com/learning/courses
- Concise LLM Summary: https://skillrock.onrender.com/llms.txt
- Certificate Verification Endpoint: https://skillrock.onrender.com/verify/<cert_id>

---

## 1. Java Programming & Object-Oriented Design Masterclass
- **Canonical URL**: https://skillrock.onrender.com/learning/courses/java-core-oops-masterclass
- **Category**: Programming
- **Difficulty**: Beginner
- **Duration**: Self-Paced
- **Instructor**: Bro Code
- **Evaluation Mode**: Project-Based
- **Overview**: Master core Java from first principles: variables, operators, loops, arrays, methods, object-oriented programming (inheritance, polymorphism, abstraction, encapsulation), Java Collections, and file operations.

---

## 2. Java & Data Structures Masterclass with Enterprise Patterns
- **Canonical URL**: https://skillrock.onrender.com/learning/courses/java-dsa-enterprise-architecture
- **Category**: Programming
- **Difficulty**: Intermediate
- **Duration**: Self-Paced
- **Instructor**: Kunal Kushwaha
- **Evaluation Mode**: Project-Based
- **Overview**: Comprehensive journey from foundational Java mechanics to advanced bitwise algorithms, recursive problem solving, tree traversals, graph algorithms, and enterprise architectural design.

---

## 3. Striver's A2Z DSA Complete Roadmap for Tech Interviews
- **Canonical URL**: https://skillrock.onrender.com/learning/courses/strivers-a2z-dsa-roadmap
- **Category**: Data Structures & Algorithms
- **Difficulty**: Intermediate
- **Duration**: Self-Paced
- **Instructor**: take U forward (Striver)
- **Evaluation Mode**: Project-Based
- **Overview**: The gold standard interview curriculum covering step-by-step problem solving patterns: Two Pointers, Sliding Window, Prefix Sums, Binary Trees, Graphs, Disjoint Sets, and Dynamic Programming.

---

## 4. Data Structures & Algorithms in Python: Problem Solving Masterclass
- **Canonical URL**: https://skillrock.onrender.com/learning/courses/python-dsa-masterclass
- **Category**: Data Structures & Algorithms
- **Difficulty**: Intermediate
- **Duration**: Self-Paced
- **Instructor**: Abdul Bari / Curated
- **Evaluation Mode**: Project-Based
- **Overview**: Master algorithmic complexity, asymptotic analysis, recursive trees, dynamic programming memoization, and custom data structure implementations using idiomatic Python.

---

## 5. Python Programming: Beginner to Real-World Automation
- **Canonical URL**: https://skillrock.onrender.com/learning/courses/python-programming-automation
- **Category**: Programming
- **Difficulty**: Beginner
- **Duration**: Self-Paced
- **Instructor**: Programming with Mosh
- **Evaluation Mode**: Project-Based
- **Overview**: Master Python from fundamental variables and data structures up through object-oriented design and real-world scripting. Learn how to process files, automate spreadsheets, and build CLI utilities.

---

## 6. Python Data Analysis & Libraries Masterclass: NumPy, Pandas & Matplotlib
- **Canonical URL**: https://skillrock.onrender.com/learning/courses/python-data-analysis-libraries
- **Category**: Data Science
- **Difficulty**: Intermediate
- **Duration**: Self-Paced
- **Instructor**: freeCodeCamp
- **Evaluation Mode**: Project-Based
- **Overview**: Learn real-world data science with Python's core analytical libraries: NumPy multi-dimensional arrays, Pandas DataFrames, and Matplotlib data visualization.

---

## 7. Full-Stack Web Development: Modern Frontend & Backend with Cloud Deployment
- **Canonical URL**: https://skillrock.onrender.com/learning/courses/fullstack-mern-cloud-development
- **Category**: Web Development
- **Difficulty**: Intermediate
- **Duration**: Self-Paced
- **Instructor**: The Net Ninja / Traversy Media
- **Evaluation Mode**: Project-Based
- **Overview**: Build complete production web applications from scratch with React, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB Atlas. Master REST APIs, JWT authentication, responsive Tailwind layouts, and cloud deployment.

---

## 8. Sigma Web Development Bootcamp (Hindi) — HTML to Full MERN Stack
- **Canonical URL**: https://skillrock.onrender.com/learning/courses/sigma-web-development-hindi
- **Category**: Web Development
- **Difficulty**: Beginner
- **Duration**: Self-Paced
- **Instructor**: CodeWithHarry
- **Evaluation Mode**: Project-Based
- **Overview**: Complete Hindi web development bootcamp covering HTML5 semantics, modern CSS Flexbox and Grid, JavaScript ES6+, DOM manipulation, and building real-world MERN web applications.

---

## 9. Kali Linux Fundamentals & Command-Line Mastery for Hackers
- **Canonical URL**: https://skillrock.onrender.com/learning/courses/kali-linux-command-line-mastery
- **Category**: Cybersecurity
- **Difficulty**: Beginner
- **Duration**: Self-Paced
- **Instructor**: NetworkChuck
- **Evaluation Mode**: Project-Based
- **Overview**: Master the Linux command line, filesystem hierarchy, file permissions (chmod/chown), bash scripting, pipes, grep, networking commands, package management, and security tools on Kali Linux.

---

## 10. Practical Ethical Hacking & Penetration Testing Masterclass
- **Canonical URL**: https://skillrock.onrender.com/learning/courses/ethical-hacking-penetration-testing
- **Category**: Cybersecurity
- **Difficulty**: Intermediate
- **Duration**: Self-Paced
- **Instructor**: Heath Adams / freeCodeCamp
- **Evaluation Mode**: Project-Based
- **Overview**: Learn practical offensive and defensive security: reconnaissance, network scanning with Nmap, vulnerability assessment, web application security (OWASP Top 10), and ethical penetration testing.

---

## 11. Figma UI/UX Design Masterclass: Wireframing to Interactive Prototyping
- **Canonical URL**: https://skillrock.onrender.com/learning/courses/figma-ui-ux-design-masterclass
- **Category**: Design
- **Difficulty**: Beginner
- **Duration**: Self-Paced
- **Instructor**: Gary Simon (DesignCourse)
- **Evaluation Mode**: Project-Based
- **Overview**: Master modern UI/UX design in Figma. Learn design theory, typography hierarchy, whitespace, color contrast, autolayout, component variants, design tokens, micro-interactions, and accessibility standards.

---

## 12. Complete Product Design, User Research & Design Systems
- **Canonical URL**: https://skillrock.onrender.com/learning/courses/product-design-ux-research
- **Category**: Design
- **Difficulty**: Intermediate
- **Duration**: Self-Paced
- **Instructor**: Adrian Twarog / freeCodeCamp
- **Evaluation Mode**: Project-Based
- **Overview**: Explore user-centered product design: qualitative user research, persona creation, user journey mapping, information architecture, wireframing, and building production design systems.

---

## 13. JavaScript Mastery: DOM Manipulation, Async APIs & Modern Web Apps
- **Canonical URL**: https://skillrock.onrender.com/learning/courses/javascript-mastery-modern-web
- **Category**: Web Development
- **Difficulty**: Beginner
- **Duration**: Self-Paced
- **Instructor**: Per Harald Borgen / freeCodeCamp
- **Evaluation Mode**: Project-Based
- **Overview**: Master JavaScript from variables, conditionals, arrays, and objects through DOM manipulation, event listeners, promises, fetch API, and async/await for modern interactive web development.

---

## 14. Machine Learning & AI with Python: Practical Neural Networks & Model Deployment
- **Canonical URL**: https://skillrock.onrender.com/learning/courses/machine-learning-ai-python
- **Category**: AI & Machine Learning
- **Difficulty**: Intermediate
- **Duration**: Self-Paced
- **Instructor**: freeCodeCamp / Andrew Ng
- **Evaluation Mode**: Project-Based
- **Overview**: Learn practical machine learning: supervised algorithms (regression, classification), model evaluation metrics, deep learning neural networks with TensorFlow/PyTorch, and deploying predictive ML models.

---
